title: Composed Output -- a saved, validated definition built from registered building blocks
description: Domain-agnostic. A user- or AI-authored report/view/alert/workflow definition. References ONLY registered building blocks (never raw SQL/code); carries provenance so every element drills two ways. See composable-outputs.md SS3/SS4. Reuses the existing provenance vocabulary (prompt_version, sources[], run_id) -- no fork.

registered_entity.description: The registered entity this output is built on (e.g. transaction, trip, task, document, listing, shipment).

blocks.description: Registered building blocks composed into this output. NO freeform SQL/queries/code.

expression.description: ONLY for kind=derived: a constrained expression over OTHER registered block_ids. Never raw SQL/code.

depends_on.description: block_ids this block derives from (the provenance spine for derived blocks).

authored_by.description: Who composed it. ai / ai_then_user REQUIRE ai_provenance (validated + traceable).

ai_provenance.description: Required when authored_by is ai or ai_then_user. Reuses the existing provenance vocabulary -- NO fork.

run_id.description: FK to the Agent-Run record (two-way-traceability.md Agent-Run section).
